metadata.source: Compiled from EVE University Wiki, EVE Forums, and EVE Ref (as of 2026)
metadata.notes: Updated: kill_priority and threat added to all entries. Added Karybdis Tyrannos, Scylla Tyrannos (combat log names for Drifters), Starving Damavik, Ruptured Drifter Battleship, Ruptured Shackling Leshak, Marker Enforcer Disparu Troop, Tyrannos Typhon. Drifter ship-type entries marked library-only (combat log uses Karybdis/Scylla). Source: EVE Ref SDE, EVE Uni Wiki, live gamelog verification. Updated 2026-06-02.

Rogue Drones.general_notes: Swarm behavior; use Multibody Tracking Pylons or Bioluminescent Clouds for advantage. Susceptible to Deviant Automata Suppressor.

npcs.name: Bathyic Abyssal Overmind
npcs.behaviors: Long range, poor tracking; lure with frigates

npcs.name: Blastgrip Tessera
npcs.behaviors: Short range (2+4km), extreme DPS, pinpoint tracking

Drifters/Seekers.weak_to: Omni (50% uniform resists); use highest DPS ammo
Drifters/Seekers.general_notes: Poor tracking; pre-damaged HP; high sensor strength (unjammable). Seekers have thin armor, cruiser sig.

npcs.name: Karybdis Tyrannos
npcs.behaviors: Spawns at 50% HP already kiting — can be 80km+ from entry point immediately. Send drones the moment you land or it escapes range entirely. No EWAR. Dies fast if you catch it early. Every second it lives wastes time and gate distance.

stats.notes: Tier-dependent HP/DPS. This is the name all Drifter battleships use in combat log.

npcs.name: Scylla Tyrannos
npcs.behaviors: EWAR varies by subtype — check Type column in overview. Nullwarp: scram (kill First). Nullcharge: neut (kill First). Entanglement: web (kill Early). COMBAT LOG NAME for all Drifter cruisers.

stats.notes: Generic entry — all Drifter cruisers appear as Scylla Tyrannos in combat log. Priority depends on subtype.

npcs.name: Ruptured Drifter Battleship
npcs.behaviors: Damaged Drifter Battleship variant; reduced HP.

npcs.name: Tyrannos Typhon
npcs.behaviors: Cradle of War addition (June 9, 2026). Kites at 300m/s like Karybdis. Super weapon disabled; automated defenses active. 60km optimal. Stats are early-data placeholders — verify after expansion launch.

stats.notes: Placeholder stats from SDE pre-launch. Update after June 9, 2026.

Sleepers (Lucid).weak_to: Not specified; poor tracking on BS
Sleepers (Lucid).general_notes: All have remote repairs; kill small first. Cruisers have high tracking. BS is DPS check, orbit <10km to evade.

npcs.name: Lucid Deepwatcher
npcs.behaviors: High tank; timeout killer. Starts 50% armor, 65% structure

stats.notes: Solo in T1-2, pairs T3-4, trios T5-6

Triglavian Collective.weak_to: Explosive > Thermal (armor heavy: 60 EM, 48 Th, 53 Kin, 36 Exp)
Triglavian Collective.general_notes: Disintegrators ramp DPS (frig 5%/cycle, cruiser/BS 2%). Vila variants spawn drones (weak, ignoreable). Remote armor reps on some. Use ECM drones to reset ramp. Explosive ammo best.

npcs.name: Starving Damavik
npcs.behaviors: Heavy close-range neut; very fast (2700 m/s); ramping disintegrator damage. Will drain cap before you can kill it if ignored.

npcs.name: Ruptured Shackling Leshak
npcs.behaviors: Damaged Shackling Leshak variant; reduced HP.

EDENCOM/CONCORD (Disparu Troop).general_notes: Thermal/Explosive rockets (variants: Spark EM, Ember Th, Strike Kin, Blast Exp). Keep moving. Marshals repair shields if idle.

npcs.name: Attacker Marshal Disparu Troop
npcs.behaviors: High DPS vs slow ships; keep moving

npcs.name: Marker Enforcer Disparu Troop
npcs.behaviors: Painter cruiser; makes you easier to hit by other EDENCOM ships.

Angels (Lucifer).general_notes: Fast; webs/neuts/scrams. Cynabal is tough with web/neut/fast speed. Dangerous in dark weather (speed bonus).

npcs.name: Elite Lucifer Cynabal
npcs.behaviors: Boss. Actively targets and destroys drones — pull drones immediately or lose them. Heavy neut + web. Highest priority in Angel room.

npcs.name: Elite Lucifer Dramiel
npcs.behaviors: Fast tackle frigate. No drone aggression but dangerous in groups.

npcs.name: Lucifer Cynabal
npcs.behaviors: Also targets drones aggressively. Neut + web. Kill early to protect your drone bay.

npcs.name: Lucifer Echo
npcs.behaviors: Scram + web frigate. Pins you in place. Kill first to restore mobility.

npcs.name: Lucifer Fury
npcs.behaviors: Neut frigate. Drains cap at close range.

Sansha (Devoted).general_notes: High DPS with webs/neuts. Knight is high DPS/web/neut.
